results.title: SHOW/TIME
results.overview: In an aging tea house in Monga, Taiwan, a 93-year-old woman, regulars, attendants, and a stray cat share the rhythms of daily life.When a Japanese theater director enters, fiction seeps into reality, turning the tea house into a stage—a magical moment where life and performance intertwine.

results.title: A Plot of Fate
results.overview: An ordinary mother–daughter quarrel takes an unexpected turn after a visit to a mountaintop temple.What starts as a familiar clash of wills quietly slips into something uncanny, where destiny seems to intervene at the most unpredictable moment.

results.title: The Days of Poncho
results.overview: Poncho raps on the streets until his father finds out he quit school and forces him to work delivering gas tanks. Between music, work, and tension with his dad, Poncho faces the weight of growing up.

results.title: Nelly Rapp – The Gateway to the Underworld
results.overview: When Nelly reunites with her mother, she learns that an ancient vampire intends to open the gateway to the underworld—where a slumbering evil waits to be unleashed. Together with Valle and London, they must stop the vampire before disaster strikes.

results.title: Hasip and Nasip
results.overview: In a town named "Hasımlar", the mayoralty has alternated between Hasip and Nasip for years. But when their childhood sweetheart Perihan returns to town and a third candidate emerges, the established order between the two old friends is disrupted. Both Hasip and Nasip, wanting to win the mayoralty and Perihan's heart, throw the town into turmoil with their increasingly malicious election promises and traps.

results.title: Free Therapy
results.overview: A young Man reckons with his life alongside an eccentric Therapist, both finding different ways of coping with pain.

results.title: I Best Remember Endings and Beginnings
results.overview: The author recalls high school outings in a small town and a friend group that grew apart after going to college.

results.title: The Animals
results.overview: After another man is hailed as a hero, an insecure boyfriend becomes determined to prove that he, too, can protect the woman he loves.

results.title: Conceivable
results.overview: When faced with an unexpected pregnancy, a couple in midlife must navigate their beliefs, relationships, and the support of their community. A compelling story that explores the complexities of family, faith, and the choices that define us.

results.title: Bluebird
results.overview: Noah leaves London behind for the industrial banks of the Thames, where they’re invited into a state of in-between, as the city fades away and the river turns to sea.  Searching for direction on the quiet banks, they encounter a dancer, whose movement gives form to Noah’s unspoken thoughts. Stirred by the moment, they’re then met with a mysterious figure who reawakens their sense of purpose and hope. Noah begins to mirror the shifting landscape, learning to find comfort in flux.  A meditative, voiceover-driven film written by Zohrab Yoncali, based on the PhD research of artist Nic Farr.

results.title: In The Weeds
results.overview: An obsessive husband discovers an unkillable weed that begins to threaten his suburban and so-called "perfect life."

results.title: Dante
results.overview: Raúl, a bodyguard on the verge of retirement, works alongside his son. Upon returning to work after an accident, he accepts an order to get rid of his boss's dog, Dante, a decision that puts him at odds with his son. Following failed attempts, Raúl confronts his feelings of obsolescence and must decide how far he will go to maintain his status.

results.title: THE EXORCIST
results.overview: The Exorcist (2025)  Who taught us that black magic is bad magic? In an experimental vertical format video, Krade explores the taboos surrounding witchcraft, the etymology of the word "necromancy", and the link between colonialism and folk magic. This short film, published in three parts on Instagram and YouTube,  belongs to a larger and ongoing work, including a self-published essay.

results.title: War of the Worlds
results.overview: Collage film built upon the audio of The War of the Worlds, directed and narrated by Orson Welles. Originally broadcast in October 1938 as a Halloween prank, the program famously triggered mass panic across the United States, as its format—presented as a series of live news bulletins—proved uncannily convincing. Absorbing the visual language of the contemporary media environment, W:A:R:O:F:T:H:E:W:O:R:L:D:S constructs a peculiar media-archaeological artifact. AI-generated videos, drone footage, feature films, video games, and online fragments converge with the original radio broadcast, creating a layered and unstable field of perception.

results.title: Cuando las niñas crecen
results.overview: A 10-year-old girl gets her first period. Confused and overwhelmed, she faces the reality of growing into womanhood.

results.title: Nesting
results.overview: A man attempts to appease his mysterious kidnapper who showers him with suffocating, distorted affection.

results.title: Shoulders
results.overview: On their fifth date, a woman uncovers a dark secret about her seemingly perfect boyfriend.

results.title: Drones
results.overview: A sleepwalking student, a mysterious miniature artist, an ancient witch, a doll house of trapped souls, and a cop cursed by love collide in a surreal world.

results.title: The Act of Cutting Away
results.overview: Insurmountable medical bureaucracy pushes Roland, a transmasculine college student, to the absolute brink. Desperate for top surgery but blocked by systemic gatekeeping, his reality fractures when he discovers a classmate running a clandestine, illegal dissection operation. What started as a struggle against healthcare politics instantly devolves into a grim, body-horror bargain for survival.
